text:
```yaml
name: Run tests on label

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [labeled]

jobs:
  run-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Determine if tests should run
        id: determine
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const pr = context.payload.pull_request;
            const isExternal = pr.user.type === 'User';
            const hasLabel = pr.labels.some(l => l.name === 'run-tests');
            if (!isExternal || !hasLabel) {
              core.setOutput('run', 'false');
              return;
            }
            const org = context.repo.owner;
            const username = context.actor;
            const res = await github.request('GET /orgs/{org}/members/{username}', {org, username});
            const isMember = res.status === 204;
            core.setOutput('run', isMember ? 'true' : 'false');

      - name: Checkout repository
        if: steps.determine.outputs.run == 'true'
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        if: steps.determine.outputs.run == 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        if: steps.determine.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run tests
        if: steps.determine.outputs.run == 'true'
        run: npm test
```
